query: SELECT tml.id, t.name as tabac, m.name as molecule, tml.concentration, tml.notes FROM tabac_molecule_links tml JOIN tabacs t ON tml.tabac_id = t.id JOIN molecules m ON tml.molecule_id = m.id;
